wiki.title: Bill Wielechowski
wiki.extract: Bill P. Wielechowski (born December 7, 1967) is an American lawyer serving as a Democratic member of the Alaska Senate representing District K, which is located in Northeast Anchorage, Alaska. Prior to the 2022 redistricting process, he represented District H from 2015 to 2023. Wielechowski also previously represented District J from 2007 to 2013.
